274669030.description: This vintage Sheaffer set includes a ballpoint pen and mechanical pencil, both finished in brushed stainless steel. Each features a sleek design with a shiny chrome clip and the distinctive Sheaffer white dot. The set comes with the original Sheaffer instruction manual for use and refilling. Both writing instruments are in very good used condition with minor signs of wear. No personalization or engravings are present. Suitable for collectors or vintage office use.
